# Managed by Ansible (sn09.yml). Do not edit on the server.
#
# Regular search engines are allowed, with Galaxy's standard exclusions for
# dynamic / stateful endpoints. Known LLM / AI training crawlers are blocked
# and an experimental AI-training opt-out directives is set for the
# general case, allow indexing/search, disallow AI training.
#
# The AI user-agent list is used from https://robotstxt.com/ai
#
# --- General policy (legitimate search engines) ---
User-agent: *
Disallow: /display?
Disallow: /display_as?
Disallow: /training-material/
Disallow: /tool_runner?
DisallowAITraining: /
Content-Usage: ai=n
Content-Signal: search=yes, ai-input=no, ai-train=no
